execution: sequential; one fresh isolated worktree and ephemeral session per attempt; no treatment result sharing
controls: same task prompt per paired settings
no live services or production changes
primary_outcomes: independent acceptance pass/fail and cases passed
wall seconds from process start to completion
grading: Freeze acceptance cases before measured runs. Grade first-attempt tree, not later repairs. Review anonymized diffs when possible; disclose model-based grading limitations.
cost_formula: ((input-cached-cache_write)*10 + cached*1 + cache_write*12.5 + output*50)/1000000; reasoning is a subset of output, not added twice
limits: three researcher-selected tasks in one private repository
three stochastic repeats per cell; descriptive case study, no universal causal claim
unversioned model alias and backend hardware cannot be pinned
shared server-side cache cannot be cleared; report cached and cache-normalized costs separately
timeouts/failures remain in results; missing token counts remain missing
private source and raw transcripts are not public release artifacts
baseline_setup: bun install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts with Bun1.3.14; lock/tree unchanged; same restore in each worktree
